units.source_text: 敢是宿世因缘吧，这更衣生下了一个容华如玉、盖世无双的皇子。

en.t: Perhaps it was a bond from a previous life; this lady of the wardrobe gave birth to an imperial prince as beautiful as jade and without equal in the world.

units.source_text: 皇上急欲看看这婴儿，赶快教人抱进宫来[\[3\]](#part1330.html#m3)。

en.t: The emperor was eager to see the baby, and quickly ordered someone to carry him into the palace[\[3\]](#part1330.html#m3).

units.source_text: 一看，果然是一个异常清秀可爱的小皇子。

en.t: At first sight, he was indeed an exceptionally graceful and lovely little prince.
